label: review-assembly
argv:
from pathlib import Path
import datetime,hashlib,json,subprocess
binary=Path("build/release/merge_bench")
destination=Path("results/p5/assembly")
destination.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def digest(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
before=digest(binary)
records=[]
def capture(argv,path):
 r=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
 path.write_text(r.stdout)
 assert not r.stderr,r.stderr
 records.append({"argv":argv,"exit_code":r.returncode,"output":str(path),"output_sha256":digest(path)})
 return r.stdout
symbols=capture(["nm","-S","-C",str(binary)],destination/"symbols.txt")
selected=[]
for line in symbols.splitlines():
 parts=line.split(maxsplit=3)
 if len(parts)!=4:continue
 address,size,kind,symbol=parts
 if "clone .cold" in symbol:continue
 if "::merge_once<" in symbol and any("tiplog::merge::"+name+">" in symbol for name in ("StdPQ","BinHeap","Quad","Loser")):
  touch="true" if "merge_once<true" in symbol else "false"
  kernel=next(name for name in ("StdPQ","BinHeap","Quad","Loser") if "tiplog::merge::"+name+">" in symbol)
 elif symbol=="tiplog::merge::StdPQ::replace_top(unsigned long)":touch="wrapper";kernel="StdPQ"
 else:continue
 start=int(address,16);end=start+int(size,16)
 path=destination/(kernel+"-touch-"+touch+".txt")
 capture(["objdump","-d","-C","--start-address="+hex(start),"--stop-address="+hex(end),str(binary)],path)
 selected.append({"kernel":kernel,"touch":touch,"symbol":symbol,"start":hex(start),"end_exclusive":hex(end),"assembly_file":str(path)})
versions={tool:subprocess.run([tool,"--version"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.splitlines()[0] for tool in ("objdump","nm","g++")}
commands=json.loads(Path("build/release/compile_commands.json").read_text())
assert before==digest(binary)
out={"status":"passed","created_utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"scope":"Read-only release generated-code extraction; no benchmark execution or performance claims","binary":str(binary),"binary_sha256":before,"versions":versions,"compile_commands":[x for x in commands if x["file"].endswith(("bench/micro/merge_bench.cpp","src/tiplog/merge/kernels.cpp"))],"source_sha256":{str(p):digest(p) for p in (Path("bench/micro/merge_bench.cpp"),Path("bench/micro/bench_log.hpp"),Path("src/tiplog/merge/kernels.hpp"),Path("src/tiplog/merge/kernels.cpp"))},"selected_symbols":selected,"commands":records}
Path("results/p5/assembly-review.json").write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"status":out["status"],"symbols_saved":len(selected),"binary_sha256":before,"summary":"results/p5/assembly-review.json"}))
